name: Gaming Desk Cable Management Kit 10-piece

description: Protect your cards from digital theft with this RFID-blocking slim wallet. Holds 8 cards and cash, yet fits in any pocket without the bulk. Durable vegan leather with stitched reinforcement.

description: Effortless layered look with three complementary necklaces — delicate chain, coin pendant, and bar necklace. 18K gold plating over hypoallergenic brass. Tarnish-resistant and skin-safe for sensitive skin.

description: Eliminate pressure and pain on long drives with this orthopedic gel seat cushion. Memory foam core with cooling gel top layer provides unmatched comfort. Non-slip base keeps cushion firmly in place.
